items.text: Why are French students taking to the streets? Around 400 schools shut as protests spread across the country
items.article: Around 400 French high schools have been closed as student protests over teacher shortages, overcrowding and poor facilities spread nationwide, with clashes, fires, and arrests prompting the government to step up security talks. Around 400 secondary schools across France were closed on Friday, 2 October, as a rapidly expanding student protest movement over education conditions escalated into clashes, fires, and blockades. The closures affect roughly 400 of France's 3,700 high schools, with the Education Ministry saying classes at affected institutions would move online where possible. Education Minister Edouard Geffray said the decision was primarily intended to protect students and staff after violence was reported at several schools. The protests began in the Paris region in late September and have since spread to cities including Marseille, Strasbourg, Toulouse , Rennes, Lille, and Nantes. Students have been blocking school entrances and demanding more teachers, smaller classes, better-maintained buildings and greater resources for schools. Their complaints are not just limited to staffing . Students have also raised concerns about long school days, classrooms becoming excessively hot during periods of high temperatures, inadequate facilities, and buildings in urgent need of repair. items.key: ai:why uk diesel prices have breached the £2 per litre mark
items.text: Why UK diesel prices have breached the £2 per litre mark
items.article: The average price of a litre of diesel at the pump stands at an all-time high of 200.01p, according to the RAC motoring body. The price of diesel in the UK has breached the £2 per litre mark for the first time, as the fallout from the US-Israel war with Iran continues to drive up costs. Over the past seven months, the Iran war has severely disrupted the production and transportation of oil across the region, causing the price of fuels made from crude to surge. Motor fuel prices fell back when the US and Iran agreed in June to a framework deal to end the fighting, but rose again as tensions resurfaced. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump has responded to rising prices by mulling a ban on US diesel producers selling overseas - a move which could push UK prices even higher. Crude oil is a key ingredient in petrol and diesel, which means that higher wholesale costs make filling up a car more expensive. The price of petrol and diesel is also heavily influenced by demand and refining capacity. Analysts say every $10 (£7.55) per barrel increase in the oil price pushes up pump prices by roughly 7p a litre.

items.text: Where N-Dubz members are now from 'billionaire boyfriend to cryptic feud'
items.article: As N-Dubz announce plans for a 2027 UK arena tour, the Mirror takes a look at what Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer are up to nowadays, including a mysterious row that unfolded earlier this year Mere months after N-Dubz fans feared they'd never see the trio on stage together again, a UK reunion tour has been announced for 2027. Tula 'Tulisa' Contostavlos , Costadinos 'Dappy' Contostavlos and Richard 'Fazer' Rawson will be setting out on their eagerly awaited The Legacy Tour across February and March, with eight arena dates in the diary. It's unclear whether the Camden-bred group will be announcing any additional dates, but longtime fans will now doubt have their booking fingers at the ready when p re-sale tickets go on sale from 10 am Wednesday, October 7. N-Dubz made their mark on British music with their distinct hip-hop sound and use of slang, making hit after hit. After a 11-year hiatus, during which they pursued solo paths, N-Dubz re-formed in May 2022, with their single Charmer followed by a sold-out tour. It seemed as though the group was riding high once more, but behind the scenes, things weren't so rosy. Dappy later claimed he hadn't been paid for the UK arena tour, pledging never to perform with N-Dubz again. It would appear he has now put his grievances aside, but you can safely bet there may be more drama to come. Here, the Mirror takes a look at the rollercoaster lives of Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer, which have proven eventful whether together or apart...

items.key: ai:gypsy rose blanchard's ex ken urker's sister reveals his last words to her
items.text: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's Ex Ken Urker's Sister Reveals His Last Words to Her
items.article: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's ex-fiance Ken Urker’s sister, Autumn, recalled his last words to her before his death as she broke down on TikTok Live The sister of Gypsy Rose Blanchard ‘s late ex-fiancé Ken Urker shared the touching last words her brother said to her before his death . Shortly after news broke that Ken had been found dead on his 34th birthday on Thursday, October 1, Autumn Urker went live on her TikTok account . Autumn was visibly emotional throughout the livestream, breaking down and sobbing uncontrollably. Reflecting on their final conversation, she told her followers that Ken’s last words to her were, “I love you.” It is unclear when the exchange took place. The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office in Louisiana confirmed Ken’s death to Us earlier on Thursday, saying its officers had “responded to a residence” after “receiving a call at 6:15 p.m.” Authorities confirmed Ken “was found dead upon arrival” and added, “At this time, we are continuing the death investigation.”
